turns.content: 各客户等级的订单金额分布

turns.sql: WITH level_stats AS ( SELECT c.customer_level, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(o.order_amount) AS total_order_amount, AVG(o.order_amount) AS avg_order_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_level IN ('战略客户', '重点客户', '普通客户') GROUP BY c.customer_level ) SELECT customer_level, customer_count, order_count, total_order_amount, avg_order_amount, ROUND( total_order_amount * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(total_order_amount) OVER (), 0), 4 ) AS amount_ratio FROM level_stats ORDER BY total_order_amount DESC;
